title: Asian Games: Joanie Delgaco finishes 6th in women’s single sculls
summary: Joanie Delgaco wrapped up her women’s single sculls campaign at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Games with a sixth-place finish in Final A on Thursday at the Nagaragawa International Regatta Course here.
